data.title: Proceedings of the 2026 XCSP3 Competition
data.description: arXiv:2611.22420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This document constitutes the proceedings of the 2026 XCSP3 Competition. The results of this competition of constraint solvers were presented at FLOC (Federated Logic Conference) 2026 Olympic Games, held in Lisbon, Portugal from 20th to 29th July, 2026.
data.author: Gilles Audemard, Christophe Lecoutre, Emmanuel Lonca
